step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows DBS Bank's quantitative pricing engine running on AWS. Internal users (traders) interact with external data and send pricing requests to an Application Load Balancer. The ALB routes traffic to the Pricing Engine running inside Amazon ECS. The Pricing Engine stores payloads in ElastiCache for Redis (Payload cache) and places tasks in Redis Task Queues. Task Queues transition items to Processing Queues. Two types of worker clusters running in ECS (Pricing Workers CPU and Pricing Workers GPU) pull tasks from Task Queues, perform mathematical computations, retrieve and save payloads back to Redis Payload cache.
